tcad_track.mesh: DEVSIM structured mesh; Gmsh optional for later irregular geometry
tcad_track.baseline_scope: complete T01 single-gate drift-diffusion numerical gate plus complete T02 dual-gate numerical gate and all five numerical T03 groups: P4-L, P1 bias-and-coupling, P2 bottom-interface and bulk traps with preserved V1/V2 failures and passed V3, P3 contact with preserved V1 failure and passed V2, and P5 V_t-only temperature sensitivity with passed formal runner and independent persisted-evidence check
tcad_track.next_scope: establish and commit M01 Xyce build/tool preflight revision-3 with token-safe scope checks and preserved R02 contract failure; do not rerun R01/R02 or execute a device netlist
tcad_track.m00_contract_boundary: The E3 M00 static contract freezes 13 source tables, five formal-fit datasets, nine training curves with 163 scored points, four whole-condition holdout curves with 70 scored points, seven zero-VDS invariants, a simulator-independent teaching kernel, 11 bounded coefficients, deterministic optimization, separate linear/log metrics, failure retention, model-route boundaries and a local validity domain. No compact-model fit, TCAD, ngspice, AIM-Spice or circuit simulation ran for the contract. A future M00 PASS may only establish agreement with qualified project teaching-model numerical curves; it is not experimental calibration, independent external validation, physical parameter extraction, simulator cross-validation or circuit evidence.
tcad_track.m00_r01_failure_boundary: The only formal R01 run completed deterministic training and post-fit holdout scoring. Its optimizer converged in 18 function evaluations, and training/holdout aggregate linear NRMSE values were 0.0799203/0.123434 while log RMSE values were 0.0832202/0.148789 decade. The L=12 um holdout transfer gm proxy relative error was 0.512384, above the frozen 0.50 limit, so the runner remains 21/24 PASS and E0/FAIL. The other two failed checks are expected consequences because simulator candidates and their artifact-completeness gate are disabled after a numerical failure. Inputs, optimizer log, 247 selected rows, predictions, residuals, parameters, validity and two figures are preserved. No independent PASS-only check, ngspice, AIM-Spice, TCAD or circuit ran, no candidate model was generated, and M01/downstream remain closed. The fitted coefficients and curves are failed teaching-surrogate diagnostics, not accepted or physical model parameters.
tcad_track.m00_r02_contract_boundary: The E3 R02 structural-recovery contract keeps the R01 registry bytes, 9-curve/163-point train split, 4-curve/70-point whole-condition holdout, current floor, curve weights, optimizer, metrics, every acceptance threshold and local validity domain unchanged. A pre-fit identifiability audit uses only the committed split and equation: eight training curves are at the 10 um reference length and only one is at a non-reference 8 um length, while R01 exposed two free length coefficients. R02 therefore fixes the analytic geometry factor to Lref/L with exponent exactly 1.0, removes length_exponent from optimization, retains length_vth_slope_v as the sole train-fitted length coefficient with a neutral zero initial value, and reduces the bounded fit coefficients from 11 to 10. No R01 holdout metric or fitted coefficient selects the R02 structure, fixed exponent, initial vector, bounds or thresholds. This is a regularizing teaching assumption, not proof of physical inverse-length scaling. The contract check runs no fit, TCAD, SPICE or circuit, preserves R01 as E0/FAIL, and leaves M01/downstream closed.
tcad_track.m00_r02_execution_chain_boundary: The revisioned R02 runner and standard-library independent checker are implemented and the synthetic kernel/SciPy probe passes. The runner fixes the Lref/L exponent at 1.0, exposes 10 bounded coefficients, refuses all existing R02 outputs, optimizes only the frozen 9-curve/163-point training set and loads the 4-curve/70-point holdout after optimizer termination. The independent checker separately reconstructs rows, the fixed-exponent kernel, residuals, metrics, VTH/gm, artifacts and route boundaries without importing the runner, NumPy or SciPy, and refuses to overwrite its report. This is E2 execution-chain self-test evidence only: no formal R02 data optimization, holdout scoring, model candidate, TCAD, SPICE or circuit execution has occurred, M00 remains E0, and M01/downstream remain closed.
tcad_track.m00_r02_formal_result_boundary: The single permitted R02 formal run completed after commit 56a4215: deterministic training used 9 whole-condition curves and 163 scored points, then loaded the untouched 4-curve/70-point holdout. Runner evidence is 24/24 E2; the independent standard-library persisted-evidence checker is 20/20 E3. Train aggregate linear/log NRMSE is 0.0830935/0.0838732 decade and holdout is 0.109299/0.142615 decade; holdout VTH proxy errors are 0.0218637 and 0.00917274 V, and gm proxy relative errors are 0.363249 and 0.419248, all within the unchanged thresholds. Ten fitted coefficients remain teaching-surrogate coefficients, not physical parameters; lambda_per_v and log_gmin are strictly inside but close to their lower bounds and no robustness margin was preregistered. The 12 runner artifacts, 247-row manifest/prediction set, 13 curve metrics, 10-row parameter table, two figures, IGZO-only behavioral candidate and unexecuted Level-15 candidate are persisted with hashes. Candidate files are generated-only and neither ngspice nor AIM-Spice ran; TCAD, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed. M00 closes only as an IGZO-only structurally regularized teaching compact surrogate fit to qualified project numerical curves with a local validity domain. It is not experimental fitting, physical parameter extraction, independent external validation, simulator validation, native HSPICE Level 61 execution, a circuit-ready model or quantitative circuit evidence. The next gate is the M01 simulator cross-check contract.
tcad_track.m01_contract_boundary: The E3 M01 revision-3 contract freezes the 247 selected R02 target rows (233 scored: 163 train and 70 holdout; 7 zero-VDS invariants and 7 repeated-low-VDS audits; 13 curves), target and manifest hashes, W=60 um, L=8/10/12 um, 300 K, source=0 V, VBG/VTG/VDS port mapping, absolute drain-current-per-width units, the R02 ngspice behavioral candidate, the R02 AIM-Spice Level-15 candidate and mapping, tool fingerprints, route syntax, no-SnO/no-HZO/no-circuit exclusions, linear/log route-to-target metrics, route-difference reporting, exclusive outputs, failed-route retention and the two-route laptop budget. Contract checking performs no simulator invocation and creates only its own report; revision-1 and revision-2 checker failures are preserved separately. External baseline folders are reference-only. A future M01 run may compare two executed simulator routes against the frozen IGZO teaching rows, but it cannot claim equation identity, experimental calibration, physical parameter extraction, native Level 61 behavior for ngspice, circuit readiness or foundry validation; C00 and downstream remain closed until execution and independent persisted-evidence checks pass.
tcad_track.m01_preflight_execution_chain_boundary: The revision-1 M01 tool/provenance preflight chain was implemented and committed as a no-device-netlist gate. It bound the revision-3 M01 contract and frozen IGZO candidates, refused existing outputs, permitted exactly one ngspice --version subprocess, read only the AIM-Spice executable fingerprint, and prohibited AIM-Spice process invocation, device netlists and numerical curves.
tcad_track.m01_r01_preflight_failure_boundary: After execution-chain commit a6386d2 was pushed, the R01 preflight ran exactly once and returned 11/13 with E0/FAIL. The ngspice fingerprint, no-netlist argv and ngspice-42 version gates passed. The AIM-Spice executable fingerprint was read without launching the process, but the user-reported unauthorized copy failed auditable license provenance and its documented reproducible batch CLI remained not established. The only subprocess was ngspice --version; no netlist argument, device simulation, numerical SPICE curve, route table, plot or circuit output was created. The JSON report and raw preflight log are retained with hashes. This is a tool/provenance gate failure, not an ngspice or AIM-Spice numerical failure and not an IGZO device result. M01 remains E0/FAIL and C00/downstream remain closed. Only an explicitly open-source second-simulator recovery contract may be established next, and it must be committed before any device-level netlist execution.
tcad_track.m01_open_source_recovery_contract_bounda: The E3 M01 open-source recovery contract revision-1 preserves the historical revision-3 contract and the R01 11/13 E0/FAIL unauthorized AIM-Spice provenance result by path and SHA-256. It replaces the disqualified second route with a pure-source GPL-3.0-or-later Xyce 7.10.0 build, rejects proprietary XyceNF binaries, and maps the same frozen IGZO-only M00 R02 behavioral candidate text to ngspice and Xyce without claiming equation identity. Source review found Xyce support for limit(), sgn(), .func user functions, B-level 1 expression sources, positional netlists, -l logs and -o output basenames; this is static syntax evidence only. The contract freezes the 247 target rows, two-route laptop budget, batch templates, self-test requirements, exclusive outputs, failure retention and no-device-execution boundary. No Xyce binary, device netlist, SPICE numerical curve, physical parameter, experimental calibration or circuit result was created. M01 stays E0/FAIL until a committed build/tool preflight, two device-only DC runs and an independent persisted-evidence check pass; P3, P5, C00, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
tcad_track.m01_xyce_build_preflight_contract_bounda: The revision-1 Xyce build/tool preflight contract pins official Xyce 7.10.0, Trilinos 14.4, SuiteSparse 7.8.3 and CMake 3.30.5 archives by URL and SHA-256. It preserves the prior recovery contract/report unchanged while recording that their unverified Xyce archive string ended in 541cfecf, whereas independent rehashing of both the original and stable copied archive ends in 541fecf; the new build input uses the latter actual hash. The contract freezes a serial two-job, MPI-off, Fortran-off user-local source build, rejects proprietary binaries, and implements a controlled scalar B-source self-test followed by a parser-only -syntax check of the frozen IGZO candidate. Contract checking invokes no simulator and creates no device or numerical output. The future scalar self-test is tool evidence rather than an IGZO equation or device result, and the parser-only device input cannot be counted as a DC solution. Formal M01 two-route device DC, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed until the committed preflight and its independent persisted-evidence check pass. R01 execution then failed at SuiteSparse CMake because the runner did not pass explicit BLAS/LAPACK library paths; that E0 failure and its independent failure check are preserved, and R02 must add the paths without overwriting R01.
tcad_track.m01_xyce_build_preflight_r01_failure_bou: The committed revision-1 build/tool preflight ran exactly once after ee5116e and returned 14/29 E0/FAIL; the independent persisted-evidence check returned 9/20 E0/FAIL. All four source archives, hashes and six tool probes passed. SuiteSparse configuration stopped because CMake could not discover BLAS_LIBRARIES in the user-local library directory; no SuiteSparse install, Trilinos/Xyce build, Xyce binary, scalar self-test, parser-only candidate check, device netlist solution or formal M01 output was created. The runner report, independent report, preflight log, command logs, source/build manifests and partial SuiteSparse cache are retained. No ngspice, AIM-Spice, TCAD, circuit, layout, PEX or HZO process was invoked. R01 is not retried; R02 registered explicit BLAS/LAPACK paths and unique build/output roots but its static contract checker failed 3 scope/marker checks before any build. R03 must preserve both failures and correct only the token-safe checker markers.
tcad_track.m01_xyce_build_preflight_r02_contract_fa: The revision-2 R02 static contract checker ran exactly once and returned 22/25 E0/FAIL without invoking a simulator. The failed checks were candidate scope token matching (the comment word translation contains the substring tran) and wrapper source markers for the no-formal runner/independent-check boundary; the BLAS/LAPACK paths, source hashes, R01 failure binding and output isolation checks passed. The E0 report results/reports/m01_xyce_build_preflight_contract_r02.json is immutable. No R02 configure/build command, Xyce process, device netlist or numerical output ran. R03 may correct only the token-safe scope check and static wrapper markers, with a new contract report and unique namespace.
tcad_track.evidence_boundary: T02-C closes only the frozen teaching-model numerical gate. T03-P4-L adds one complete E3 three-point channel-length group while retaining the failed ideal 1/L diagnostic. Numerical P1 is complete through E3 P1-BIAS and P1-CAP-RATIO substages; the latter varies a fixed-total-coupling allocation proxy and is not measured capacitance, measured Al2O3 permittivity, or a fabricated asymmetric stack. The T03-P2 bottom-interface DIT substage has E3 contract, equation-smoke, formal three-point transfer-sensitivity, persisted-state, and independent-check evidence. The bulk-trap input contract is E3 static evidence, and its zero-control, NTA-reference, and NGA-reference equation smoke completed 3 devices and 21 coupled DC solves with E2 runner evidence and E3 independent persisted-evidence verification. Formal V1 completed 8 devices, 328 converged DC records and 248 transfer points but correctly remained E0/FAIL because NTA=5e19 did not bracket the unchanged 1e-5 A/cm VTH criterion by VTG=1.0 V and the inherited near-zero internal-potential gate was inapplicable to nonzero occupied trap charge. Formal V2 completed 8 devices, 440 converged DC records, 360 transfer points, 8 states and 48 VTK files but correctly remained E0/FAIL because the diagnostic VTH+0.2 V gm evaluation lacked the upper neighbor required by the frozen central-difference method. Both failures, their exact inputs, runners, logs, curves, states and reports are preserved; no V2 independent check was run. The V3 E3 static contract changed only the common gate-grid stop from 1.7 V to the user-approved 1.8 V and retained every density point, equation, extraction method, acceptance threshold and evidence boundary. The subsequent V3 runner completed 8 isolated devices, 456 converged DC solves, 376 transfer points, 8 states and 48 VTK files with E2 evidence; the independent persisted-evidence checker passed 16/16 at E3 and closes P2 within the frozen quasi-static teaching-model boundary. NTA shows increasing VTH and SS proxies with decreasing gm, while NGA shows increasing VTH and decreasing gm but a mildly decreasing SS proxy; these directions are diagnostics, not physical mechanism or completion gates. P3 contact V1 completed all 12 devices, 243 converged DC solves, 156 reported points, 3 states and 18 VTK files, and passed 24 of 25 runner gates, but remains E0/FAIL because its relative terminal-current imbalance gate was incorrectly applied to nine external-VDS=0 numerical-noise points. Its maximum nonzero-VDS relative imbalance was 3.35344e-11 and its zero-VDS maximum absolute current was 1.08454e-19 A/cm, both within the unchanged thresholds; no V1 independent check was run. The V1 config, runner, report, log, tables, figures, states, original failure manifest and filename-collision supplement are preserved. The P3 V2 E3 static recovery contract changed only gate applicability and unique output/archive paths: the unchanged 1e-5 relative threshold applies at external VDS>0, while the unchanged 1e-16 A/cm absolute threshold applies at external VDS=0. R_pair*W=0/0.5/4.5 kOhm*um, physical/model inputs, bias grid, extraction and the 12-device/243-DC/156-point budget remained unchanged. The subsequent single V2 run completed 12 devices, 243 converged DC solves, 156 points, 3 states and 18 VTK files; all 25 runner gates passed at E2 and the independent checker passed 20/20 at E3. The maximum nonzero-VDS relative terminal-current imbalance was 3.35344e-11, the maximum zero-VDS absolute current was 1.08454e-19 A/cm, circuit KCL and Ohm-law residuals were 2.42178e-12 and 1.20922e-12, and voltage-partition residual was zero. The high resistance proxy reduced the sampled high-gate current by 0.161396% and the extracted external total-resistance-width proxy increased from 2780.13345 to 2784.63204 kOhm*um; these are controlled numerical responses, not physical contact parameters. V2 completion does not reinterpret V1 as PASS. The two nonzero magnitudes remain E1 literature anchors mapped by an explicit project total-pair teaching convention; they are not project measurements, TLM extraction, Ti/Ni project parameters or barrier/injection evidence. P3 is complete only within the frozen uncalibrated 2D teaching-model boundary. The P5 E3 static contract froze 250/300/350 K and only V_t=8.617333262e-5*T in the existing Scharfetter-Gummel current. The single formal run then completed 3 fresh devices, 123 converged DC solves, 93 transfer points, 3 states and 18 VTK files; all 14 runner gates passed at E2 and the independent checker passed 15/15 at E3. The maximum terminal-current imbalance was 4.37301e-10 and the 300 K curve, state, VTH and gm reproduced T02-C exactly. Across 250/300/350 K, the VTH proxy was 0.245409/0.263857/0.281977 V, SS proxy was 117.138/137.594/157.796 mV/dec, gm proxy was 3.98472e-5/3.93760e-5/3.88128e-5 S/cm, low-gate current proxy was 4.03293e-11/2.10090e-10/6.94544e-10 A/cm, and high-gate current proxy was 3.64698e-5/3.59372e-5/3.52925e-5 A/cm. Mobility remained fixed at 35.5 cm2/(V*s), while DOS, band parameters, permittivities, contacts, traps, geometry and biases remained fixed. Thus all five numerical T03 groups are complete only within the frozen uncalibrated teaching-model boundary. These results do not establish experimental or physical IGZO temperature dependence, activation energy, mobility/DOS/contact/trap temperature laws, physical SS/VTH/Ioff/Ion, operating range, self-heating, reliability, uncertainty, compact models, circuit cells, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence.

teaching_baseline.allowed_use: T01 teaching-parameter initialization and sanity checks
teaching_baseline.prohibited_use: experimental fitting or calibrated dual-gate prediction

baseline_process.top_gate_status: research extension; not present in the stated fabricated baseline

logic_style.principle: Use a second gate to tune the load-device effective threshold while the driver network implements n-type ratioed logic.
limitations: ratioed logic has static current in the low-output state
noise margin and output swing require load/driver sizing
active-load claims require a calibrated dual-gate threshold shift

evidence_boundary: Teaching and research PDK only; not foundry sign-off. The ngspice model is a behavioral equivalent, not native HSPICE Level61. Active-load logic remains planned until dual-gate threshold control is calibrated.
